datasheet_identity.title: SS52C THRU SS520C Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier

extraction_notes: The SS56C-specific forward trace is the dashed SS55C-SS56C family curve in p. 2 Fig. 3; the figure is typical at Tj = 25 degC, pulse width = 300 us, and 1% duty cycle.
The SS56C-specific reverse trace is the solid SS52C-SS56C family curve in p. 2 Fig. 4 at Tj = 25 degC; its 0-100% x-axis was mapped to reverse voltage using SS56C VRRM = VDC = 60 V.
The datasheet states that the cathode line denotes the cathode end. Reverse-curve voltage and current points are recorded as positive reverse-voltage and reverse-current magnitudes.

Tabulated VF and rated reverse current are maximum values; tabulated junction capacitance is a typical value. The separate Ta = 100 degC reverse-current row of 50 mA was not used for the 25 degC extraction.
No reverse-recovery time or breakdown voltage/current measurement is published. The 60 V VRRM/VDC rating is a maximum blocking rating, not a breakdown measurement.
The Fig. 1 derating curve and Fig. 2 surge-current curve were not extracted because they are thermal and surge-rating curves rather than diode electrical model curves.
